name: medicaid-estate-recovery-2026
title: Medicaid Estate Recovery and Home-Transfer Deeds, 50 States and DC (2026)

fields.name: code
fields.description: Two-letter postal code

fields.name: name
fields.description: State or District name

fields.name: recovery_scope
fields.description: How far Medicaid estate recovery reaches. probate_only means the probate estate only; expanded means the state adopted the optional expanded estate of 42 U.S.C. 1396p(b)(4)(B); expanded_partial means some non-probate assets but not all

fields.name: recovery_scope_note
fields.description: How the scope was determined, plus liens, recovery from a surviving spouse's estate and service limits

fields.name: recovery_statute
fields.description: Governing statute or rule citation

fields.name: recovery_statute_url
fields.description: Official URL of the governing statute or rule

fields.name: state_plan_4_17_a_url
fields.description: Medicaid State Plan Attachment 4.17-A or the agency manual section on estate recovery, where found; blank if not found

fields.name: life_estate
fields.description: Whether Medicaid estate recovery can reach a house passing at the recipient's death by a traditional life estate. n/a means the method is not recognized in the state

fields.name: life_estate_note
fields.description: Plain-English reason for the life_estate classification

fields.name: life_estate_cite
fields.description: Section relied on for the life_estate classification

fields.name: lady_bird_deed
fields.description: Whether Medicaid estate recovery can reach a house passing at the recipient's death by a lady bird (enhanced life estate) deed. n/a means the method is not recognized in the state

fields.name: lady_bird_deed_note
fields.description: Plain-English reason for the lady_bird_deed classification

fields.name: lady_bird_deed_cite
fields.description: Section relied on for the lady_bird_deed classification

fields.name: tod_deed
fields.description: Whether Medicaid estate recovery can reach a house passing at the recipient's death by a transfer on death deed. n/a means the method is not recognized in the state

fields.name: tod_deed_note
fields.description: Plain-English reason for the tod_deed classification

fields.name: tod_deed_cite
fields.description: Section relied on for the tod_deed classification

fields.name: joint_tenancy
fields.description: Whether Medicaid estate recovery can reach a house passing at the recipient's death by joint tenancy with right of survivorship. n/a means the method is not recognized in the state

fields.name: joint_tenancy_note
fields.description: Plain-English reason for the joint_tenancy classification

fields.name: joint_tenancy_cite
fields.description: Section relied on for the joint_tenancy classification

fields.name: revocable_trust
fields.description: Whether Medicaid estate recovery can reach a house passing at the recipient's death by a revocable living trust. n/a means the method is not recognized in the state

fields.name: revocable_trust_note
fields.description: Plain-English reason for the revocable_trust classification

fields.name: revocable_trust_cite
fields.description: Section relied on for the revocable_trust classification

fields.name: tod_deed_recognized
fields.description: yes if the state has a statutory transfer on death or beneficiary deed for real property (Maryland counted, effective 2026-10-01)

fields.name: tod_deed_statute
fields.description: Transfer on death deed statute

fields.name: tod_deed_effective
fields.description: Date the transfer on death deed act took effect (YYYY-MM-DD, or a year where only the year is established)

fields.name: tod_deed_uniform_act
fields.description: yes if based on the Uniform Real Property Transfer on Death Act

fields.name: lady_bird_deed_recognized
fields.description: yes only where a statute, reported case or state Medicaid rule recognizes a life estate deed with a retained power to sell without the remainder beneficiaries' consent

fields.name: lady_bird_authority_type
fields.description: Kind of authority recognizing the lady bird deed

fields.name: lady_bird_authority
fields.description: Citation for the lady bird deed authority, or what was searched

fields.name: hardship_waiver_home
fields.description: State hardship or deferral rules tied to the home, with citation

fields.name: recovery_exemptions_note
fields.description: State additions beyond the federal floor of 42 U.S.C. 1396p(b)(2)

fields.name: karp_2005_scope
fields.description: Classification in Karp, Sabatino and Wood, AARP Public Policy Institute (2005)

fields.name: last_verified
fields.description: Date the row was checked

fields.name: sources
fields.description: Semicolon-separated list of URLs actually read

fields.name: confidence
fields.description: high means the operative text was read on an official government site; medium means a mirror, agency manual or State Plan; low means secondary sources only

fields.name: flags
fields.description: Uncertainties, conflicts between statute and manual, recent amendments, and what could not be read
